patterns.note: Content sections feature generous vertical padding, often with a single, large heading centered or left-aligned, creating an airy and spacious feel.
A highly distinctive, oversized serif typeface is used for all major headings, contrasting sharply with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text, navigation, and labels.
The site uses a sophisticated, muted palette dominated by warm off-whites and dark browns, accented by subtle, rich gradients (gold, teal, purple) in background elements.
As the user scrolls, text elements slide up and fade into view, while background images exhibit a subtle parallax effect, creating depth and a dynamic reveal of content.
Hero sections are characterized by minimal text, focusing on a single, impactful headline and a full-width background image or gradient that often parallaxes.

technique_notes: To rebuild the scroll-triggered motion, use a JavaScript library like locomotive-scroll or GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate element reveals. Text blocks should animate with a subtle slide-up and fade-in as they enter the viewport, while background images should scroll at a slower rate than foreground content to achieve a parallax effect.

The typography system relies on a custom, decorative serif font for display headings, which should be rendered at very large sizes to serve as visual anchors. This is paired with a highly legible, modern sans-serif for all functional text, ensuring a clear hierarchy and readability.

The site's color scheme can be achieved by setting a dominant warm off-white as the primary background, using a deep, muted brown for primary text and dark elements, and incorporating subtle, multi-color gradients for background accents that provide visual interest without overwhelming the minimal aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, artistic serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a luxurious, flowing character, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant, with very subtle rounding (barely perceptible) on card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, characterized by expansive vertical padding between sections and generous line-heights, creating a sense of calm and luxury.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and artistic use of an oversized, custom serif typeface for headings, which acts as a primary visual element. This, combined with a sophisticated, muted color palette and subtle scroll-triggered animations, elevates the design beyond a typical corporate site into a high-end, editorial experience. The large, stylized 'LimeIQ' logo reveal in the footer also reinforces this unique brand identity.
